items.summary: In the backend, hardcode the principal `mgyr5-y3u63-q5gfr-gvkv7-etmf3-nz3hc-uxmc2-7glom-54ilt-kpuzm-vae` as the designated admin. Any `isAdmin` check must return `true` for this principal without requiring any approval record. This principal must never be subject to the approval flow — it should always be treated as fully approved and as an admin regardless of any stored approval state.

In the frontend, update the post-login routing logic in `frontend/src/App.tsx` so that when the authenticated user's principal matches `mgyr5-y3u63-q5gfr-gvkv7-etmf3-nz3hc-uxmc2-7glom-54ilt-kpuzm-vae`, they are immediately routed to the admin panel (or home dashboard) and never redirected to the `PendingApprovalPage` or `RejectedPage`.
